Address Boss feedback from QA testing.

feature_requests.title: Long-running request timeout with user consent and performance logging
feature_requests.description: When a chat request exceeds a configurable threshold, show a modal asking if the user wants to continue.

behavior.threshold: Configurable from MongoDB or environment variable (e.g., 30s default)
behavior.first_trigger: After threshold elapsed: overlay modal 'This is taking a long time. Do you want to continue?'

options.no_abandon: User clicks No -> request is abandoned, response discarded
options.yes_continue: User clicks Yes -> keep waiting. Ask again at each multiplier of threshold (2x, 3x, etc.)

behavior.repeat: Each multiplier of the timeout threshold re-asks the question

performance_logging.trigger: After request completes (success, abandon, or error) AND after user completes consent path

implementation_notes: Frontend: modal overlay with Yes/No radio buttons
Frontend: AbortController to cancel fetch on abandon
Backend: timeout threshold from env var or admin.config collection
Backend: performance record written after consent path completes

deliverables.task: Performance tuning — end-to-end response time optimization
deliverables.detail: Profile and optimize: startup time (FIPS load 2x, ~120s), provider search latency (BUG-PERF-001, 87s VA), embedding call overhead, MongoDB query patterns, cold start reduction.

After every deploy, run a warmup script that hits /health (waits for 200), then fires a test provider search and specialty query to force FIPS load, MongoDB connection pool init, and OpenAI client init. First real user gets a warm server. Add to all deploy workflows (deploy-findcare-backend.yml, manual deploys).

deliverables.task: Compound vector search indexes — city+embedding, county+embedding, state+embedding
deliverables.detail: Create compound indexes on providers collection: {practice_address.city, embedding}, {county.name, embedding}, {practice_address.state, embedding}. These allow MongoDB Atlas vector search to pre-filter by geography before scoring embeddings, eliminating full-collection scans. Directly addresses BUG-PERF-001 (87s VA search).

indexes.purpose: State-scoped vector search (current index, verify exists)

deliverables.task: Automated UAT status updates on commit
deliverables.detail: When Claude commits a bug fix or feature, automatically update the UAT status in MongoDB. No manual reseeding. The commit message contains the feature ID and classification — parse it and update the DB as part of the commit workflow.
deliverables.origin: AI operational error during Cycle 1 — manual reseed was required because UAT timestamps were out of sync.

deliverables.task: Automate UAT report via HuggingFace Space config injection
deliverables.detail: Investigate: can we parameterize HUMAN_TESTING via HF Space API or redirect? Goal: Claude triggers a fresh UAT session programmatically without Boss manually editing secrets. Options: HF API to update secrets, redirect with query param, or environment variable injection from GitHub Actions deploy workflow.
deliverables.origin: Manual secret editing during Cycle 1 was error-prone. UAT report display should be automated as part of deploy pipeline.
